table.name: Team
table.emailCount: {count, plural, =0 {No addresses} one {# address} other {# addresses}}

teams.emptyLead: You don't lead any team yet. A Super Admin can make you a team lead.
teams.leadNote: You can add or remove members and choose the on-call person for the teams you lead. Names, email lists, the Teams webhook and archiving are managed by Super Admins.

form.name: Name
form.emailsHint: One address per line. They get the “new ticket” and P1 emails for this team.
form.webhookHint: The incoming-webhook or workflow URL from Microsoft Teams. It is stored securely and never shown again.
form.webhookNotSet: No webhook — Teams posts are skipped for this team.
form.onCallHint: Paged by SMS for P1 tickets. Only members with an international phone number can be chosen.
form.onCallPhoneMissing: {name} has no international phone number: SMS pages will be skipped.
form.onCallNotMember: {name} is no longer a member of this team.
form.readOnly: Only Super Admins can change this.

members.title: Members
members.removeBody: They stop seeing this team's queue straight away. Tickets assigned to them stay assigned.
members.leadAccountNote: Leads with the Team Lead account role can manage this team in the admin.
members.saveFirst: Create the team first, then add its members.
members.archivedNote: Restore the team to add members.

teams.archiveWarning: Archived teams disappear from pickers and the New ticket routing. A team can't be archived while active categories route to it, it has open tickets or active escalation rules. Nothing is removed.

form.emailHint: They sign in with Microsoft using this address. The account is linked on their first sign-in.
form.emailLocked: The email address can't be changed.
form.name: Full name
form.roleHint: Team Leads also need to be the lead of a team (Teams & members).
form.phoneHint: International format, for example +974 5555 1234. Used for on-call SMS pages.
form.noTeams: Not a member of any team.
form.selfNote: You can't change your own role or disable your own account.
form.revokeNote: Changing the role or disabling the account signs this person out everywhere.

staff.created: {name} can now sign in with Microsoft

form.name: Name
form.domainsHint: One per line, e.g. hamad.qa. People who sign up with an address on these domains join this organisation automatically.

clients.archiveWarning: Clients of an archived organisation can still read their tickets but can't raise new ones, reply or upload files. New sign-ups stop joining it. Nothing is removed.

sites.title: Sites
sites.name: Site name
sites.saveFirst: Create the organisation first, then add its sites.

pending.intro: People who signed up with an address that no organisation claims. Approve them into an organisation or reject them.
pending.unverifiedNote: They haven't confirmed their email address yet. After approval they see nothing until they do.
pending.rejectBody: Their account is disabled: they can't sign in, and this address can't be used to sign up again. You can still approve it later from the rejected sign-ups.
pending.rejectedNote: This sign-up was rejected and the account is disabled. Approving it into an organisation restores it.

whoCanSee.staff: Only Super Admins can open this section.
whoCanSee.clients: Only Super Admins can open this section. Clients never see it.
